attributes.title: Reflected XSS in /search via q parameter
attributes.vulnerability_information:
## Summary
The `/search` endpoint on https://staging.acme-shop.example.com reflects the `q` query parameter back into the response body without HTML-encoding it, allowing arbitrary JavaScript injection in the victim's browser.

## Steps To Reproduce
1. Open https://staging.acme-shop.example.com/search?q=%3Cscript%3Ealert(1)%3C/script%3E in any browser.
2. Observe that the payload is reflected verbatim inside the rendered HTML.
3. The injected script tag executes — confirmable via the `alert(1)` popup.

```
curl 'https://staging.acme-shop.example.com/search?q=<script>alert(document.cookie)</script>'
```

## Impact
An attacker can hijack the session of any authenticated user who clicks a crafted link — exfiltrating session cookies and acting on their behalf.

## Attack Scenario
Unauthenticated attacker delivers the crafted URL to victims via phishing email or social-media post.
